description: Runs a read-only SPARQL 1.1 SELECT or ASK query against the Artsdata Knowledge Graph (https://query.artsdata.ca/query) and returns the result as SPARQL 1.1 Query Results JSON, exactly as the endpoint returns it: head.vars and results.bindings for SELECT, boolean for ASK. Call get_schema first and build the query from the classes, properties, prefixes and conventions it returns, since Artsdata's model is not general knowledge. Declare every PREFIX you use and always add a LIMIT: at most 1000 rows are returned (the rest is cut and truncated is true; page with OFFSET), and a query gets 25 seconds. If the endpoint rejects the query, its error message is returned so you can fix the query and retry. For the details of an entity URI in the results use get_entity; to find an entity's URI from its name use search_entities.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for the sparql_query tool.

query.description: A complete SPARQL 1.1 SELECT or ASK query, with a PREFIX declaration for every prefix it uses. Build it from the classes, properties and prefixes returned by get_schema, and add a LIMIT.

inputSchema.title: SparqlQueryRequest

name: sparql_query

datatype.description: Datatype IRI of a typed literal.

type.description: 'triple' is an RDF-star quoted triple, whose value is an object with subject, predicate and object terms.

xml:lang.description: Language tag of a language-tagged literal.

outputSchema.description: Response schema for the sparql_query tool: the endpoint's SPARQL 1.1 Query Results JSON (https://www.w3.org/TR/sparql11-results-json/), as returned. A SELECT gives head.vars and results.bindings; an ASK gives boolean.

boolean.description: The answer to an ASK query.

vars.description: The projected variable names, without the leading '?'.

bindings.description: One object per solution, keyed by variable name. Unbound variables (e.g. from OPTIONAL) are absent.

truncated.description: Present and true when the endpoint returned more rows than the server's row cap and only the first rows are included. Add or lower the LIMIT, or page with OFFSET.

outputSchema.title: SparqlQueryResponse
